description: This file defines configuration structures, functions, and options for the ANTLR runtime in Go, including debugging, tracing, and memory management settings.

classes.name: runtimeConfiguration
classes.description: Holds various boolean flags for configuring the ANTLR runtime, such as debugging and tracing options.

methods.name: ConfigureRuntime
methods.description: Applies a list of runtime options to configure the global runtime settings.

methods.name: WithStatsTraceStacks
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable stack trace collection for memory debugging.

methods.name: WithLexerATNSimulatorDebug
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable debug logging for the lexer ATN simulator.

methods.name: WithLexerATNSimulatorDFADebug
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable DFA debug logging for the lexer.

methods.name: WithParserATNSimulatorDebug
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable debug logging for the parser ATN simulator.

methods.name: WithParserATNSimulatorTraceATNSim
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable trace logging for the parser ATN simulator.

methods.name: WithParserATNSimulatorDFADebug
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable DFA debug logging for the parser.

methods.name: WithParserATNSimulatorRetryDebug
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable debug logging when retrying parser decisions.

methods.name: WithLRLoopEntryBranchOpt
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable optimization of recursive loop operations.

methods.name: WithMemoryManager
methods.description: Returns a runtimeOption to enable or disable custom memory management for garbage collection optimization.
